company.what_they_do: web-library.net is a public email / disposable-address service. It provides users with email addresses under its domain for the purpose of receiving messages, positioning itself as a privacy-oriented or shared-mailbox service. Despite its homepage disclaimer that it is 'not a throwaway email service,' it is widely recognised in the anti-spam and developer communities as a free, anonymous email provider whose addresses are routinely used to bypass registration requirements.
